observations.content: Bootstrapped Doxa's standard landing-gate infrastructure for this repo: KG Guard + Claude Code Review GitHub Actions workflows, kg-save-gate/review-gate/test-gate PreToolUse hooks, session-start-kg-import + pre-compact-kg-export hooks, attest-review.sh + knowledge-graph-merkle.cjs (CommonJS, this repo's package.json has type:module), and this initial .knowledge-graph/graph.json. Ported from openclaw's landing-gates suite per doxa-cns CLAUDE.md PR-visibility/bank-the-gold/kg-save-on-every-merge doctrine. claude-code-review.yml's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret is NOT yet configured on GitHub — workflow is inert until Garth adds it.

demo/ is deployed with Vercel, so a .vercel/ directory appears there on every local deploy. demo/.gitignore keeps it out of the tree — it was sitting untracked and unbanked until the 2026-09-02 fleet sweep.

2026-11-06 (The-Doxa-Way-CNS spec the-doxa-way-control-tower F6): this repo's KG becomes CNS source scripture-grounding-mcp (authority/registry.yaml). Fleet-wide facts are held by the CNS meta-KG or by the other CNS sources (doxa-app, openclaw, doxa-shared), so this repo's copies were removed (federated, they opened conflicts; the Decision ones queue for Garth): ReviewWorkflowDeadCondition, KgMergeIntegrityGuard, ReviewGatePrHeadResolution, FleetSecurityBaseline20261103, CanonicalFleetGates, FleetGates, KgMerkleFixesPropagated, KgGuardRequiredCheckNaming. LandingGatesInfra (two other repos held different facts under that name) was renamed ScriptureGroundingLandingGatesInfra. Rule: kg-save only facts about THIS repo here, under a repo-scoped name. A gate or fleet fact is a kg-save in The-Doxa-Way-CNS; a gate re-render PR here carries no KG change (title it chore(sync): ..., which KG Guard exempts).

Garth 2026-11-11 order: one /code-review max pass before every push of code. This repo now runs the fleet-template PreToolUse hook .claude/hooks/push-review-gate.sh (rendered from doxa-cns fleet/gates; doxa-cns KG MaxReviewBeforePushDoctrine, PR #2905): a git push of new code commits (not on main) needs ATTEST_REVIEW_LEVEL=max scripts/attest-review.sh <verdict>, or a logged 'waived:' row (docs-only: 'waived: docs-only: <reason>'), or PUSH_GATE_WAIVE=<reason> for a human-review-only push (no attestation, no merge authority). Exempt: deletes, tags, notes, a tip already on main, KG-only commits. Baseline 7 days to 2026-11-11: 36 runs, 0 failures, 0 reruns.

2026-11-14 (CEO order: the 13-14 Nov work applies to ALL repos): first CLAUDE.md for this repo. CEO ownership line; what the server is (grounds, never generates); real verify commands (env -u YOUVERSION_APP_KEY npm test, keyless only without the key; npm run test:books; no lint, no build; CI runs no tests); gotchas (YOUVERSION_APP_KEY by name from ~/.config/doxa, YouVersion prior written approval for AI output so hosted surfaces stay keyless, demo Vercel project scripture-grounding-demo has no git link so deploy is vercel --prod --local-config demo/vercel.json from the main checkout under the hard timeout); landing doctrine (kg-save, max review, attest exact head SHA, push, merge). Points to The-Doxa-Way-CNS. AGENTS.md generated from it by doxa-cns generate-agents-md.mjs.

2026-11-14 scripture-grounding-mcp: the 4 PreToolUse gate hooks (kg-save, review, push-review, test) in .claude/settings.json moved from matcher Bash to Bash|Monitor; Claude Code 2.1.310 fires Bash hooks only for Bash, so git push / gh pr merge through Monitor skipped them. tests/hook-matchers-monitor.test.cjs (same file as doxa-brand #129, run by npm test) fails on a Bash-only entry.
